summary: HealthStream filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a cybersecurity incident. An unauthorized third party accessed a limited portion of its corporate file server; no customer-facing systems or protected health information were compromised, and no file encryption occurred. Certain employee, customer/vendor billing, and corporate data may have been accessed. About 75 credentialing customers had data copied to the server; they were notified. The company engaged cybersecurity and forensics specialists and informed law enforcement. Expenses are expected, but no material adverse impact is anticipated. This is a routine disclosure of an operational matter, not a special situation.
